name: Möbius Flows on the Riemann Sphere (Custom)
subtitle: 4 cards · 6 presets

cards.title: Möbius Flow T_τ(z) = exp(τA)·z
Conformal Derivative T_τ'(z) = (cz + d)^(-2)
Lie Algebra Generator V(z) = β(z² - p²)
Argument Principle (1 / 2πi) · T_τ'(z) / T_τ(z)

vars.name: pole_x
vars.expr: s_eff * (cos(axis) * sinh(2 * ur) + sin(axis) * sin(2 * ui)) / den_p

vars.name: pole_y
vars.expr: s_eff * (sin(axis) * sinh(2 * ur) - cos(axis) * sin(2 * ui)) / den_p

formula.cx: (px * sinh(2 * ur) - py * sin(2 * ui)) / den_z
formula.cy: (py * sinh(2 * ur) + px * sin(2 * ui)) / den_z

points.xExpr: (px * sinh(2 * ur) - py * sin(2 * ui)) / den_z
points.yExpr: (py * sinh(2 * ur) + px * sin(2 * ui)) / den_z
points.label: Zero z_0
